context.injuries: I am dealing with some lower back and upper back issue. So have to avoid back heavy excercises like Deadlifts and excercises that strain upper back muscles like overhead press.

plan.title: 8-Week Lean Muscle Gain & Fat Loss Program

exercises.name: Warmup & Mobility
exercises.notes: Arm circles 20x, band pull-aparts 15x, shoulder CARs 5x each, cat-cow 10x, child's pose 30s, hip flexor stretch 30s each, doorframe stretch 30s, wall slides 10x, thoracic rotation 10x each.

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Press
exercises.notes: Start 95lb. Add 5lb when all sets completed with 12 reps. Ensure a spotter if going heavy.

exercises.name: Flat Barbell Press
exercises.notes: Start 115lb. Add 5lb when all sets completed with 12 reps. Ensure a spotter if going heavy.

exercises.name: Cable Crossover (Mid-to-High)
exercises.notes: Start 20lb. Add 5lb when all sets completed with 15 reps.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raises
exercises.notes: Start 15lb. Add 2.5lb when all sets completed with 15 reps.

exercises.name: Triceps Pushdown (Rope Attachment)
exercises.notes: Start 50lb. Add 5lb when all sets completed with 15 reps.

exercises.name: Metabolic Finisher: Sled Push
exercises.notes: Push sled for 30s, rest 30s. Repeat for 10-15 minutes. Focus on consistent effort, minimal lower back strain.

exercises.name: Warmup & Mobility
exercises.notes: Leg swings 10x each, hip circles 10x, bodyweight squats 10x, ankle rolls 30s, cat-cow 10x, child's pose 30s, hip flexor stretch 30s each.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.notes: Start 200lb. Add 10lb when all sets completed with 12 reps. Focus on deep range of motion without lower back rounding.

exercises.name: Cable Pull-Through
exercises.notes: Start 60lb. Add 5lb when all sets completed with 15 reps. Focus on glute contraction, minimal lower back involvement.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.notes: Start 80lb. Add 5lb when all sets completed with 15 reps.

exercises.name: Lying Hamstring Curl
exercises.notes: Start 80lb. Add 5lb when all sets completed with 15 reps.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: Start 20lb. Add 2.5lb when all sets completed with 12 reps. Maintain upright posture, control descent.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
exercises.notes: Start 70lb. Add 5lb when all sets completed with 20 reps.

exercises.name: Metabolic Finisher: Farmer's Carry
exercises.notes: Carry heavy dumbbells for 30s, rest 30s. Focus on upright posture and core bracing, minimal lower back strain.

exercises.name: Warmup & Mobility
exercises.notes: Arm circles 20x, band pull-aparts 15x, scapular retractions 15x, cat-cow 10x, child's pose 30s, hip flexor stretch 30s each, doorframe stretch 30s, wall slides 10x, thoracic rotation 10x each.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (Wide Grip)
exercises.notes: Start 100lb. Add 5lb when all sets completed with 12 reps. Avoid excessive arching or leaning back to protect lower back.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row (Neutral Grip)
exercises.notes: Start 100lb. Add 5lb when all sets completed with 12 reps. Keep torso stable, avoid shrugging to protect upper back.

exercises.name: Machine Reverse Fly
exercises.notes: Start 60lb. Add 5lb when all sets completed with 15 reps.

exercises.name: Cable Face Pulls
exercises.notes: Start 40lb. Add 5lb when all sets completed with 20 reps. Focus on external rotation and scapular retraction to protect upper back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curls
exercises.notes: Start 25lb. Add 2.5lb when all sets completed with 12 reps.

exercises.name: Metabolic Finisher: Battle Ropes
exercises.notes: Perform various battle rope waves for 30s, rest 30s. Maintain a slight knee bend and upright posture.
